Name: A Vintage Chest Retexture
Author: StarDust0001
Description:
I have a little time to play SDV recently, so I made something one more time :D

I didn't statisfied with the vanilla chest texture, so I made a new one. It shouldn't be incompatible with any other mods except they changed the same texture.

Currenly it has a CP and AT version, select the one you like to use.
